starting.name: Prepared Clay
starting.ability: After each Materials Yard action: form 1 vessel of any Shape by paying 1 more Clay than its Clay cost. It starts Plain for free.
starting.abilityZh: 每次泥柴场行动后：支付器型费用加1泥，成型1件任意器型器物，免费获得素面。

starting.name: White Slip
starting.ability: After each Potter's Wheel action: choose 1 Plain vessel formed by that action. Pay its 2-Coin Decoration cost to replace Plain with Painted.
starting.abilityZh: 每次陶车坊行动后：选择该行动成型的1件素面器物，支付2铜钱纹饰费用，将素面替换为彩绘。

starting.name: Rapid Drying
starting.ability: After each Decoration Workshop action: choose 1 vessel decorated by that action. Pay 1 Wood + the 1-Coin Glazing cost, apply any one Glaze, then load it into an empty active Shared Kiln space or your empty Imperial Kiln, if gained.
starting.abilityZh: 每次纹饰坊行动后：选择该行动施加纹饰的1件器物，支付1柴及1铜钱施釉费用，施加任意釉色，然后装入空置的有效共窑窑位或已获得的空置御窑。

starting.name: Kiln Tending
starting.ability: Once during each Kiln Yard action, after loading at least 1 ceramic, gain 1 Clay or 1 Wood.
starting.abilityZh: 每次窑坊行动中一次：至少装窑1件后，获得1泥或1柴。

advanced.name: Large Throwing Wheel
advanced.ability: Once per round, during a Potter's Wheel action in which you form at least 1 Vase or Censer, reduce that action's total Clay cost by 2, minimum 0.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，在至少成型1件瓶或香炉的陶车坊行动中，该行动的泥总费用减少2，最低为0。

advanced.name: Measuring Calipers
advanced.ability: Once per round, after you form a vessel, if you have another vessel in your workshop, gain 2 Coins.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，成型1件器物后，若你的作坊内另有1件器物，获得2铜钱。

advanced.name: Dipping Vats
advanced.ability: Once per round, during a Kiln Yard action, the Plain ceramics loaded by that action pay no Glazing cost.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，在一次窑坊行动中，该行动装窑的素面陶瓷无需支付上釉费用。

advanced.name: Drying Frames
advanced.ability: Once per round, after a Potter's Wheel action: choose 1 Plain vessel formed by that action. Pay its 2-Coin Decoration cost to replace Plain with Carved, Impressed or Painted.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，陶车坊行动后：选择该行动成型的1件素面器物，支付2铜钱纹饰费用，将素面替换为刻花、印花或彩绘。

advanced.name: Reworking Table
advanced.ability: Once per round, during a Decoration Workshop action: before decorating 1 Plain vessel being worked, change its Shape to any other Shape. Exchange its Vessel card; pay no additional Clay.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，纹饰坊行动中：为正在处理的1件素面器物施加纹饰前，将其器型改为任意其他器型，交换器物牌，无需额外支付泥。

advanced.name: Glaze Palette
advanced.ability: Once per round, at the end of the Work Phase, before pre-firing abilities: change the Glaze of 1 of your loaded ceramics to any one Glaze at no additional cost.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，工人阶段结束时、烧成前能力结算前：免费将你已装窑的1件陶瓷改为任意釉色。

advanced.name: Carving Knives
advanced.ability: Once per round, when replacing Plain with Carved, that Decoration costs 0 Coins.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，将素面替换为刻花时，该纹饰费用为0铜钱。

advanced.name: Seal Stamps
advanced.ability: Once per round, when replacing Plain with Impressed, that Decoration costs 0 Coins.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，将素面替换为印花时，该纹饰费用为0铜钱。

advanced.name: Painting Brushes
advanced.ability: Once per round, when replacing Plain with Painted, that Decoration costs 0 Coins.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，将素面替换为彩绘时，该纹饰费用为0铜钱。

advanced.name: Colour Samples
advanced.ability: When acquired: immediately make 1 Selection below without another worker or Commission Market resource bonus. Once per round: during one Commission Market reservation, use the Selection instead of the normal choice. Selection: privately look at the top 3 Main Orders, or as many as remain. Reserve 1 of those Orders or 1 face-up Main Order. Discard looked-at Orders not reserved; update the public display normally.
advanced.abilityZh: 获得时：立即进行下述选择，无需另放工人，也不获得瓷牙行资源奖励。每轮一次：可用此选择替代瓷牙行行动中的1次承接。选择：私下查看牌堆顶3张主委托（不足则尽量查看），承接其中1张或1张公开委托，弃掉其余已查看委托；公开展示正常更新。

advanced.name: Protective Saggars
advanced.ability: Once per round, after Quality is assigned, pay 1 Wood to improve 1 of your Flawed or Standard ceramics from this firing by one level: Flawed → Standard or Standard → Fine. Cannot create a Masterpiece.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，决定品质后，支付1柴，将自己参与本次烧成的1件瑕品或良品陶瓷提升一级：瑕品→良品，或良品→上品。不能产生臻品。

advanced.name: Fuel Ledger
advanced.ability: When acquired: gain the +2 Stoke and −2 Bank Contribution cards. Each costs 2 Wood to play. They are additional choices; choose only 1 Contribution card per firing. Return played cards after firing.
advanced.abilityZh: 获得时：取得+2添柴和−2压火控火牌，每张使用费用为2柴。它们是额外可选牌；每次烧成仍只选择1张控火牌。使用后收回。

advanced.name: Test Pieces
advanced.ability: Once per round, before Contributions are chosen, if you have at least 1 ceramic participating in this firing, pay 1 Wood to privately look at the top Fire card, then return it to the top.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，选择控火牌前，若你至少有1件陶瓷参与本次烧成，支付1柴，私下查看窑火牌堆顶1张，然后放回牌堆顶。

advanced.name: Second Firing
advanced.ability: Once per round, after Quality is assigned, choose 1 of your Flawed or Standard ceramics from this firing. Reveal 1 extra Fire card and recalculate that ceramic's Actual Heat and Quality using the same Base Heat, kiln position, Kiln Furniture effect and Shifu Heat marker, but the new Fire modifier. Previous post-Fire Actual Heat adjustments do not carry over. The new Quality replaces the old, even if worse. Discard the extra Fire card.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，决定品质后，选择自己参与本次烧成的1件瑕品或良品陶瓷，额外揭示1张窑火牌。保留相同基础火候、窑位、支烧窑具效果及师傅火候标记，采用新窑火修正重新计算其实际火候与品质；先前揭示窑火后的实际火候调整不保留。新品质取代旧品质，即使更差也如此。弃掉额外窑火牌。

advanced.name: Kiln Furniture
advanced.ability: Once per round, when loading 1 ceramic into a High or Low Shared Kiln space, place this tile beneath it. Its zone modifier is 0 for this firing. Return the tile after firing.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次，将1件陶瓷装入共窑高温区或低温区时，将本牌放在其下方。本次烧成的窑位修正为0，烧成后收回本牌。
